mapper.insert: insert into synthesis_artifacts (artifact_type, title, content, compiled_at) values (#{record.artifactType}, #{record.title}, #{record.content}, #{record.compiledAt}) on conflict (artifact_type) do update set title = excluded.title, content = excluded.content, compiled_at = excluded.compiled_at
mapper.select: select artifact_type, title, content, compiled_at from synthesis_artifacts order by artifact_type asc
